subject: Emerald Analytics co-hosted EDU series + DataForum shared booth — cost & ops
messages:
From: Kara Singh <kara@emeralda.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@emeralda.io>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Emerald x Redwood — EDU webinar series + DataForum shared booth proposal

Hi Priyom & Sergio,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Emerald would love to co-host a short educational webinar series (3 x 30-minute sessions) targeted at analytics engineers and platform teams, and we also have a shared booth opportunity at DataForum (Aug 24-25, 2026) in SF.

High-level ask from our side:
- Emerald will lead program marketing to our user list; Redwood to amplify to your PLG audience and customers.
- We propose splitting booth costs and MDF on a 60/40 basis (Emerald 60%).
- Emerald will cover center signage and lead scanning hardware; Redwood would handle two speaker slots and webinar hosting logistics.

I've attached an initial MDF term sheet and the venue floorplan so you can see the booth positioning. Can you confirm interest and any constraints on budgets or branding?

Kara
Kara Singh
Head of Partnerships, Emerald Analytics
kara@emeralda.io
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: MDF_Term_Sheet_emerald_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Booth_Floorplan_DataForum_v3.png (image/png)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kara Singh <kara@emeralda.io>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emerald x Redwood — EDU webinar series + DataForum shared booth proposal

Kara — thanks, this looks promising. We're interested. A few quick Qs from our side before we dig in:

1) Can you share estimated gross booth cost and MDF amount (ballpark is fine) and payment milestones?
2) Do you have attendee targets for the webinar series and a preferred cadence (weekly/biweekly)?
3) Lead ownership and data sharing — what fields will you share (email, company, title) and timing post-event?

Looping in Laura and Marcus to handle ops and promo. Sergio, can you weigh in on speaker slots and any product collateral we should prepare?

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Kara Singh <kara@emeralda.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emerald x Redwood — EDU webinar series + DataForum shared booth proposal

Hi all — happy to coordinate. A few operational notes from Field Marketing: 

- Budget: We can commit up to $18k in MDF for shared activities (ads, paid social, email nurture) if the booth / sponsorship runs to a $45k total cost. That maps roughly to a 60/40 split in Emerald's favor; if total booth + services exceed $60k we should revisit.
- Lead sharing: Redwood requires at minimum: full name, business email, company, role, event source tag. We request leads within 48 hours of the event and permission to remarket.
- Brand: Redwood needs logo placement on the primary banner and one side panel; Emerald retains center header. We can be flexible on booth furniture if Emerald handles AV.
- Webinars: we prefer a biweekly cadence starting July 14 to run three sessions prior to DataForum. Each will be co-branded; Redwood will provide a short demo and a one-pager.

I'll attach a draft promo copy for your review and a proposed timeline.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Draft_Promo_Copy_Emerald-Redwood.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Kara Singh <kara@emeralda.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@emeralda.io>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emerald x Redwood — EDU webinar series + DataForum shared booth proposal

Laura — thanks for the clarity. Quick answers:
- Estimated gross booth + build + show services: $48,500. MDF line items (ads + targeted outreach) estimate $10k.
- Payment milestones: 50% deposit when contract signed, remainder 30 days prior to move-in.
- Lead sharing: we can provide full name, email, company, and role within 24 hours; we agree to your event source tag and remarketing permission.

Emerald is comfortable with the brand split you proposed (center header for Emerald, primary banner for Redwood). We're okay with a 55/45 cost split (Emerald 55%). Can you confirm acceptance so we can prepare a SOW and invoice?

Kara
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kara Singh <kara@emeralda.io>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emerald x Redwood — EDU webinar series + DataForum shared booth proposal

Kara — Redwood is aligned with the 55/45 split; we can approve that internally. A few additions from partner ops / content: 

- Webinar series: we propose three themed sessions (Foundations, Pipelines & Observability, Performance at Scale) — each 30 minutes with two speakers (one Emerald, one Redwood). Proposed dates: July 14, July 28, Aug 11 — biweekly cadence as Laura suggested.
- Speaker logistics: Redwood will provide slide deck templates and a short demo environment; Emerald to provide case study content.
- Promo: I'll coordinate a co-branded landing page; Marcus — can you confirm we can front the landing page build and tracking?
- Contract: please send the SOW including the 55/45 split and payment schedule. We'll review for procurement and provide a PO once signed.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
VP Partnerships | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
